title: Missing a necessary part. Written in Chinese.
text: Missing a necessary part. Written in Chinese.. This arrived and it’s missing some thing that would allow the arm to adhere to the square portion that adheres to the wall. I’m really disappointed. It looked like it was going to be a really good soap dish, but what good is it if it can’t hook to the wall like it’s supposed to and paid for. I’m also very disappointed that there aren’t directions in English with the box.  I hate it when I get things from Amazon that are written in a foreign tongue that I do not speak nor read. No English, Spanish, French or German should be written in the product description.  Amazon can send somebody to pick up this useless item. I’m glad others that rated it so high got what they paid for, I did not.
